# HexaLoam

> HexaLoam (by HexaLoam contributors) is a complete, modifiable 3D-printable 18-DOF modular hexapod robot platform with an RP-Lidar mount, editable SOLIDWORKS CAD, PLA+ STL/3MF printables, 15 engineering wiring diagrams, Arduino Mega & ESP32 firmware, Raspberry Pi & ROS2 control software, URDF, MATLAB Simscape Multibody files, and Tripod/Ripple/Wave gait demonstrations.

HexaLoam supports agriculture, inspection, LiDAR/LOAM mapping, education, and robotics research across four electronic control configurations (Configs A–D) sharing one canonical 18-joint mapping (`LF_COXA..RR_TIBIA`, IDs 0–17), CAD-derived 3R kinematics (`L1 = 86.53 mm`, `L2 = 121.06 mm`, `L3 = 202.50 mm`), and mirrored back-to-back dual-motor (`MA1`/`MA2`) joint control. Software, firmware compilation, and analytical weight/torque simulations are validated; physical hardware commissioning is staged across 11 progressive checklists (`testing/`).

## Core Pages & Releases

- [HexaLoam Homepage](https://equesai.github.io/HexaLoam/): Overview, hardware specs, interactive gait viewer, 4-configuration control/wiring selector, Bambu Studio PLA+ G-code weight table, mirrored MA1/MA2 torque profiles, FAQ, and citation.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/equesai/HexaLoam): Full CAD, 3D printables, electronics schematics, firmware, Raspberry Pi/ROS2 controller, URDF, MATLAB scripts, and tests.
- [GitHub Release v1.0.0](https://github.com/equesai/HexaLoam/releases/tag/v1.0.0): Versioned release snapshot for researchers and builders.
- [Walking Gait Videos Hub](https://equesai.github.io/HexaLoam/videos/): Side-by-side comparison of Tripod, Ripple, and Wave gaits.
- [Tripod Gait](https://equesai.github.io/HexaLoam/videos/tripod/) · [Ripple Gait](https://equesai.github.io/HexaLoam/videos/ripple/) · [Wave Gait](https://equesai.github.io/HexaLoam/videos/wave/)

## Electronics, Firmware & Control (Configs A–D)

- [Canonical Robot Config (`hexaloam_config.json`)](https://github.com/equesai/HexaLoam/blob/main/control/robot-configuration/hexaloam_config.json): Single source of truth for CAD link lengths, 18-joint mapping, and 3S 5000 mAh LiPo payload budgets.
- [Joint Mapping Table (`JOINT_MAPPING.md`)](https://github.com/equesai/HexaLoam/blob/main/control/robot-configuration/JOINT_MAPPING.md) & [Shared C++ Header](https://github.com/equesai/HexaLoam/blob/main/firmware/shared/hexaloam_joint_map.h).
- [15 Engineering Wiring Diagrams (SVG/PNG/PDF)](https://github.com/equesai/HexaLoam/tree/main/electronics/wiring) · [Power & Fuse Engineering](https://github.com/equesai/HexaLoam/blob/main/electronics/power/POWER_ENGINEERING.md) · [BOM](https://github.com/equesai/HexaLoam/blob/main/electronics/bom/BOM.md).
- [Arduino Mega 2560 Examples (01–14)](https://github.com/equesai/HexaLoam/tree/main/firmware/arduino/examples) · [ESP32 Generic Actuator Slave (PlatformIO)](https://github.com/equesai/HexaLoam/tree/main/firmware/esp32/actuator-slave).
- [Raspberry Pi Python & ROS2 Controller](https://github.com/equesai/HexaLoam/tree/main/software/raspberry-pi) · [Communication Protocol (CRC-16 Binary + JSON)](https://github.com/equesai/HexaLoam/blob/main/control/communication-protocol/README.md).
- [6 Downloadable Edition Packages](https://github.com/equesai/HexaLoam/tree/main/packages) · [11-Stage Hardware Commissioning](https://github.com/equesai/HexaLoam/tree/main/testing).

## CAD, Simulation, URDF & Verified Weights

- [CAD Gallery](https://github.com/equesai/HexaLoam/blob/main/docs/gallery.md) · [Printable STLs & 3MF](https://github.com/equesai/HexaLoam/tree/main/Printables) (Bambu Studio PLA+ G-code total excluding support: `1.306 kg` + 36 MG996Rs `1.980 kg` = `3.286 kg` base; `3.793–4.019 kg` total with 3S 5000 mAh LiPo & controllers; `+1.88 to +2.11 kg` extra top payload in Wave gait @ 70% continuous torque).
- [URDF (`simulation/urdf/hexaloam.urdf`)](https://github.com/equesai/HexaLoam/blob/main/simulation/urdf/hexaloam.urdf) · [MATLAB & Simscape Export](https://github.com/equesai/HexaLoam/tree/main/simulation) · [GLB Visual Meshes (Unity/Unreal/Blender)](https://github.com/equesai/HexaLoam/tree/main/simulation/meshes).
- [Downloadable Gait Trajectories & Torque Profiles](https://github.com/equesai/HexaLoam/tree/main/demonstrations) · [Citation (`CITATION.cff`)](https://github.com/equesai/HexaLoam/blob/main/CITATION.cff).
